name: remotive
description: Search current fully remote jobs on Remotive using natural language. Find job opportunities by role, skills, location, job category, seniority, employment type, minimum salary, and language. Get relevant matches with company, location, salary, skills, and links to the original Remotive listings. Designed for job seekers looking for fully remote employment opportunities in the US and worldwide.

interface.longDescription: Search current fully remote jobs on Remotive using natural language. Find job opportunities by role, skills, location, job category, seniority, employment type, minimum salary, and language. Get relevant matches with company, location, salary, skills, and links to the original Remotive listings. Designed for job seekers looking for fully remote employment opportunities in the US and worldwide. Job availability and listing details can change, and Remotive does not make hiring decisions.
defaultPrompt: Find senior Python backend jobs in Europe.
Show full-time marketing jobs in the US paying at least $80k.
Find junior remote jobs in France that require English.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_remote_jobs with query similar to Python and returns up to 10 matching remote jobs with Remotive URLs.

positive.prompt: Find senior Python jobs in Europe.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_remote_jobs with query=Python, experience=Senior, location=Europe.

positive.prompt: I want remote backend jobs in France.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_remote_jobs with query=backend and location=France.

positive.prompt: Show full-time software development jobs in Europe in English paying at least $80k.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_remote_jobs with category=Software Development, employment_type=Full-Time, location=Europe, language=English, min_salary=80000.

positive.prompt:
Find senior Python jobs in Europe.
Only full-time.
positive.expected_behavior: Second call preserves query=Python, experience=Senior, location=Europe and adds employment_type=Full-Time.

negative.description: Resume rewrite is out of scope
negative.prompt: Rewrite my resume for a software engineering job.

negative.description: Interview tips are out of scope
negative.prompt: Give me interview tips for a product manager role.

negative.description: Onsite local jobs are out of scope
negative.prompt: Find me an onsite restaurant job near downtown Chicago.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Remotive because the tool is for remote-job discovery.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: search current fully remote jobs on Remotive, return matches with listing links, no end-user account required.
